text:
maya: Quick sync notes from this morning's tabletop on the transient privilege escalation detection. Capturing RCA and post-incident actions so we have owners/deadlines.

samir: thanks. high-level actions: 1) tighten service-account RBAC scope; 2) enable per-project admin audit logs for 90d; 3) KMS key rotation + review key policy; 4) detection tuning to reduce false positives. I'll own RBAC item.

daria: RBAC plan: move svc-inference-runner to least-privilege: remove roles/editor, grant roles/compute.viewer + custom role with secrets.get only for needed keys. Need inventory of who uses the key.

li: on auditing — we should enable object-access audit logs (admin/data) and stream to sec-audit-bucket with lifecycle 365 days. Query suggestion:
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, timestamp
FROM `project.logging.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE "%SetIamPolicy%"
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
```

jonathan: KMS: schedule rotation for the key used by inference-secrets. We need to confirm that Dedicated deployments in us-west1 use the same key. If so, we should create a secondary key and test rewrap. I'll prototype with a canary next week. cc @daria for RBAC on key access.

ops-bot: [incident-1234] containment snapshot uploaded to https://redwood-internal/incident-1234/snapshot.tar.gz :file_folder:

daria: owning key access review. I'll run a principal access audit and post a blameless list of principals by EOD Thu.

samir: detection tuning: @oncall can you add a suppressor rule for noisy hostnames and lower severity for the specific signature? We want to avoid alert fatigue but don't suppress the rule entirely.

oncall: noted, will add suppression with 48h trial and monitor. I'll post metrics after 24h.

maya: doc updates: I created a PR to the runbook with the containment checklist + KMS rotation steps. link: https://git.redwood/infra/security/runbooks/incident-response/pull/42

jonathan: question about HSM/KMS integration — do we have HSM-backed keys for Dedicated customers or is it soft-KMS? @security-ops: we should document which customers require HSM and the onboarding steps.

sec-eng-bot: New postmortem draft created: https://docs.redwood/sec/postmortems/incident-1234-draft — feel free to add remediation text.

li: backlog items: 
- Add automated alert to flag SetIamPolicy on any inference-* service account
- Add daily KMS access snapshot to monitoring
- Update deployment template to reference secondary key for rolling rewrap

maya: owners/deadlines so we track: 
- RBAC change + rollout plan -> samir, due 2026-04-10
- KMS rotation canary -> jonathan, due 2026-04-13
- Audit stream + queries -> li, due 2026-04-09
- Detection suppressor + metrics -> oncall, due 2026-04-02
- Runbook PR review -> all, due 2026-04-01

daria: I'll also schedule a focused tabletop for secrets/KMS next Tuesday 10am — invite will go to eng-security + eng-platform + product infra.

maya: perfect. small ask: if you add any commands you ran, paste them in-thread for post-incident reproducibility. thanks :pray:

samir: adding one more: create an automated nightly job that checks for any projects with roles/editor granted to service accounts and open a ticket automatically.

oncall: will add to infra-ops backlog with priority P2.

maya: ok closing the loop for now. we'll reconvene after owners update their items. good job on the tabletop everyone :thumbsup:
